trap.label: good/bad at + -ing
trap.wrong: I am good in tell stories, bad on remember dates, terrible to say no.
trap.right: I am good at telling stories, bad at remembering dates, and terrible at saying no.
trap.why: Em português “bom em contar”, “ruim para lembrar” e “péssimo em dizer” mudam a preposição. O brasileiro traduz em por in/on e usa infinitivo. Em inglês: good/bad/terrible at + -ing.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva: “He tells stories very well.” (good at)
rewrite.answer: He is good at telling stories.
I am bad at remembering dates.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva: “She says no very badly.” (terrible at)
rewrite.answer: She is terrible at saying no.
